name: Devin and the Celestial Necropolis
source:
You've died. You're dead. But do not despair, Devin is here - with his excellent business sense, winning smile, and beautiful Celestial Necropolis. All is well. Trust Devin. He is your only friend.

[From [url=https://catnight.itch.io/devin-and-the-celestial-necropolis] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经死了。你死定了。但不要绝望，德文就在这里 - 拥有出色的商业头脑、迷人的微笑和美丽的天墓。一切都很好。相信德文。他是你唯一的朋友。

[来自[url=https://catnight.itch.io/devin-and-the-celestial-necropolis] itch.io[/url]]
